paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者认同一次普通初见之后仍可能慢慢熟悉，也认同彼此没有兴趣时可以结束这次交流。对未来其他联结保留可能，与继续追求眼前这个人不是同一件事。读者也许还没时间认识新人；开放的看法不说明实际机会。例子不要求再发消息、改变边界或保持乐观。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader allows the possibility of gradually becoming familiar after an ordinary first meeting, while also accepting an end to an exchange without mutual interest. Allowing future connection elsewhere differs from pursuing this particular person. The reader may have no time to meet anyone new; an open belief establishes no actual opportunity. The scene requires no further message, changed boundary or maintained optimism.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“只看虚构人物怎样区分未来可能性与眼前选择，不需要预测谁会喜欢谁。”听者可以提出另一种读法，不劝继续追求或保证以后一定遇到。可以只讨论一句题目，不披露约会经历；对某句话保持未评分也无需解释。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card separates a fictional person’s future possibilities from a present choice without predicting who will like whom. A listener may offer another reading without urging pursuit or promising a future encounter. Discuss just one statement without dating history; an unscored response needs no explanation.

paragraphs.zh: 新增情境与交流卡为费马编辑部原创，可只读，用于区分当前信念、具体场合和未知结果，不构成约会任务。16条仍直接评价认同程度：1强烈不同意、2不同意、3既不同意也不反对、4同意、5强烈同意。3是中立，不能替代不确定、不适用或不愿回答的未评分。四项各四条，至少三条数字才显示独立一位小数均值，例如2、3、5加一条未评分得3.3，两条则资料不足，不补零或3。不是过去三个月的反应频率，也不测实际技巧、相遇机会、他人兴趣或关系成功概率。各项可同时高、低或相同，不相减、不合总分、不选主导或分配身份。原题本尚无已建立的信效度、常模或中英文测量等值，不借用命运或成长研究量表的验证。无需联系、披露、约会、改变边界或寻求反馈；任何努力都不产生获得回应的权利。全部未评分仍开放四篇全文；原有可选标签页草稿24小时期限与完成、重测清除保持原样，复制仅含公开标题与入口，不含个人答案或均值。
paragraphs.en: These additional scenes and conversation cards are original FermatMind Editorial material for optional reading that distinguishes current beliefs, context and unknown outcomes, without assigning dating activity. Sixteen prompts retain direct agreement ratings: 1 strongly disagree, 2 disagree, 3 neither agree nor disagree, 4 agree and 5 strongly agree. Three is neutral and does not replace an unscored response for uncertainty, unsuitable wording or a declined answer. Each of four parts needs at least three numeric ratings out of four for an independent one-decimal mean. For example, 2, 3 and 5 with one unscored response give 3.3; two ratings are insufficient, without zero or three imputed. This is neither response frequency over three months nor observed skill, meeting opportunity, another person’s interest or relationship success probability. All parts can be high, low or equal without subtraction, a total, dominant outlook or identity. The original form lacks established reliability, validity, norms or English–Chinese measurement equivalence and borrows no validation from destiny or growth research scales. No contact, disclosure, dating, changed boundary or feedback is needed; effort creates no entitlement to a response. Every guide remains available with all answers unscored. Existing optional tab drafts retain their 24-hour expiry and completion or retake clearing. Copying includes only the public title and entry link, without personal answers or means.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者相信自己可以学着给提问留时间，却不确定回看尴尬交流后该怎样调整。相信可学习的部分不必在四句话上完全一致，也不代表已经表现出相应技巧。改善自己的参与，与确保别人感兴趣分别保留，例子不要求联系、练习、寻求打分或承担一次交流的全部结果。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader believes that leaving time for questions can be learned but is unsure how to revise an approach after an awkward exchange. Beliefs about learnability need not agree across all four statements or demonstrate an existing skill. Improving one’s own participation remains separate from securing another person’s interest. The scene requires no contact, practice, requested rating or responsibility for an entire interaction’s outcome.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“在虚构谈话里，人物能决定自己的哪一部分，哪些仍由别人决定？”不必给真实表现打分。听者不把相信学习当作不断自我改造的义务，也不把不认同当作懒惰；可以停留在阅读，不制定训练或约会计划。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card asks what a fictional participant can decide and what remains another person’s choice. No real performance needs a rating. A listener turns neither belief in learning into a duty of constant self-improvement nor disagreement into laziness. Reading can end without a training or dating plan.

paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, one reader can say they enjoy the present conversation while waiting for a settled plan before imagining the future. Another easily imagines a future but keeps its importance private. Different combinations of expectation and expression can have similar means. The scene infers no hurt history, attachment type or required response from guardedness and requires no disclosure as proof of openness.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我们只谈虚构人物想暂缓哪种期待、保留哪种感受，不替其规定分享速度。”可以不提供个人答案。听者不把保密当作需要突破的障碍，也不要求多讲、少想或改变联系节奏；愿意时读其他主题，也可结束。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card distinguishes a fictional person’s deferred expectation from a private feeling without prescribing a pace of sharing. No personal answer is needed. A listener treats privacy as no barrier to overcome and requires no extra disclosure, reduced imagination or changed contact. Read another theme or finish if preferred.

paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, one reader sees timing as influential but disagrees that a first impression always closes later possibilities. Another doubts the influence of their own choices while remaining unsure about appearance. Similar means make neither set of beliefs the same rule. The questionnaire observes neither opportunities nor looks and uses no belief to prove a group’s advantage or a person’s fixed worth.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“先比较虚构陈述里什么是一个观察、什么是从中延伸的预期，不给人群排等级。”无需出示经历或争论谁更值得被喜欢。听者不许诺努力一定有效，也不把限制解释成未来已定；可以对解释保留未知而停止。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card separates an observation in a fictional statement from an expectation extending beyond it, without ranking groups. No history or argument over who deserves interest is needed. A listener promises no guaranteed effect of effort and turns no limitation into a settled future. An explanation can remain unknown when discussion ends.
